'''Kaminoan Armorsmiths Ltd.''' was a company based on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

With help from [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], they designed the [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]. It proved to be the company's largest success. The company developed variants on the Phase I armor, such as the [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] and the [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|ARC trooper armor]]. They also improved upon on the Phase I variant by developing the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]], the more advanced successor of the former.
